description: Graph foundations + the [T,27,2] graph feature builder + the GCN model modules — all pure, CI-safe (no data/network/GPU). This is the architectural core every later feature depends on. Implements design sections 3 (feature format + Holistic-slot contract 3.4), 4 (graph adjacency + DecoupledGCN/ST-GCN modules + shared permute). The 374-dim features.py and its golden test stay UNCHANGED and passing (Rule 12.3 single-source-of-truth; retirement is a deliberate later commit, out of scope).
steps: Create core/signtalk_core/graph.py: frozen constants PRESET_27 (27 MediaPipe-Holistic indices from design 3.1), INWARD_EDGES (26 GRAPH-index edges from design 4), NUM_NODES=27, CENTER=0; build_adjacency(strategy='spatial', max_hop=1) -> np.ndarray (K,27,27) ported from OpenHands graph_utils.py (pure NumPy, normalized spatial partition). GRAPH indices, NOT raw MediaPipe indices (node 3/4 = shoulders).

Extend FrameLandmarks in core/signtalk_core/landmarks.py with additive full_pose: np.ndarray|None ([33,2]); in DualLandmarker.detect_frame keep the already-computed full_pose (currently discarded) and set it (None/zeros when no pose). Existing pose_subset path untouched.
Fix the contradictory module top docstring in landmarks.py so it describes the real DualLandmarker (separate Pose+Hand tasks), not the combined HolisticLandmarker.

Create core/signtalk_core/graph_features.py implementing build_graph_features(landmark_seq, cfg) -> float32 [T,27,2] per the design 3.4 contract: midline from full-pose indices 11/12; handedness exactly as features.assign_handedness (one-hand side-of-midline, two-hand leftmost-wrist-to-left, MediaPipe L/R ignored); assemble 75x2 Holistic frame (0-32 pose, 33-53 left-assigned, 54-74 right-assigned) + parallel [75] validity; apply frozen 27-index PoseSelect -> [27,2]; CenterAndScaleNormalize (shoulder-midpoint origin via graph nodes 3/4, inter-shoulder scale, scale_factor=1) with the SAME _EPS=1e-6 guard as features.py; re-zero validity-0 nodes AFTER centering; stack + linear-resample to cfg.sequence_length.

Define ONE permute_for_graph(x) -> x.permute(0,3,1,2).contiguous() ([*,T,27,2]->[*,2,T,27]) in a shared module (graph_features.py or a small models/graph_common.py) that train/serve/export/pick_thresholds will all import.

Add core/tests/golden/make_graph_golden.py (mirror make_golden.py) producing golden/input_landmarks_graph.npz + golden/expected_graph_features.npy from a deterministic clip containing BOTH a 2-hand frame AND a one-absent-hand frame; run it once and commit the fixtures.

Create core/signtalk_core/models/graph_layers.py (port DecoupledGCN spatial+temporal conv + DropGraph and the ST-GCN unit from OpenHands, pure PyTorch, no new deps); core/signtalk_core/models/decoupled_gcn.py with DecoupledGCN(nn.Module) + build_decoupled_gcn(num_classes, checkpoint_path=None, device='cpu'); core/signtalk_core/models/st_gcn.py with STGCN(nn.Module) (edge_importance_weighting=True, dropout 0.05) + build_st_gcn(...). Both accept (N,2,T,27) -> logits (N,num_classes) and mirror the build_model/build_transformer ckpt-loading contract.

Add tests: core/tests/test_graph.py (adjacency shape (K,27,27), symmetry/row-normalization, hop distances, PRESET_27 byte-identical to probe_report.json.expected_snapshot.preset_27, 26-edge count); core/tests/test_graph_features.py (exact [T,27,2] golden match atol 1e-6, node count 27, dtype float32, all-zero-pose frame -> finite all-zero output via EPS branch, absent-hand node at normalized origin); core/tests/test_graph_models.py (both models forward on random (B,2,T,27) -> (B,num_classes); permute_for_graph maps [B,T,27,2]->[B,2,T,27]).
acceptance_criteria: Running `c:\Users\ABHIMAN KUMAR\Documents\GitHub\Signtalk-AI\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest core/tests/test_graph.py core/tests/test_graph_features.py core/tests/test_graph_models.py -q` passes all new tests.
The existing 374-dim golden test core/tests/test_features_golden.py still passes unchanged.
PRESET_27 and INWARD_EDGES are frozen and asserted byte-identical to the probe-captured source; a reordered node fails the test.
build_graph_features produces finite output (no NaN) for a no-pose frame.

findings:
IMPLEMENTED (branch feat/gcn-recognizer). New modules + exact import paths for later features:
- signtalk_core.graph: PRESET_27 (tuple[int], 27), INWARD_EDGES (tuple[tuple[int,int]], 26), NUM_NODES=27, CENTER=0, build_adjacency(strategy='spatial', max_hop=1) -> np.float64 ndarray (3,27,27). Ported pure-NumPy from OpenHands graph_utils (GraphWithPartition spatial path). Graph nodes 3/4 = shoulders (MediaPipe 11/12).
- signtalk_core.graph_features: build_graph_features(landmark_seq, cfg) -> float32 [T,27,2]; and the SHARED permute helper permute_for_graph(x) -> x.permute(0,3,1,2).contiguous() ([*,T,27,2]->[*,2,T,27]). IMPORT PATH for train/serve/export/pick_thresholds: `from signtalk_core.graph_features import permute_for_graph`. EPS=1e-6 guard mirrors features.py; absent nodes re-zeroed to origin AFTER centering; validity computed internally (NOT a model channel, C=2 lock).
- signtalk_core.landmarks.FrameLandmarks: NEW additive field `full_pose: np.ndarray|None` ([33,2], default None, last field). DualLandmarker.detect_frame now sets it (None when no pose). Legacy pose_subset/features.py path untouched. Module top docstring corrected to describe DualLandmarker (separate Pose+Hand tasks).
- signtalk_core.models.graph_layers: ported layers (find_drop_size, DropGraphTemporal, DropGraphSpatial, TCNUnit, DecoupledGCNUnit, DecoupledGCNTCNUnit [renamed from OpenHands DecoupledGCN_TCN_unit], ConvTemporalGraphical, STGCNBlock [renamed from STGCN_BLOCK]). Adjacency passed in as plain np array; NO omegaconf.
- signtalk_core.models.decoupled_gcn: DecoupledGCN(nn.Module) (encoder backbone + nn.Linear FC decoder to num_classes) + build_decoupled_gcn(num_classes, checkpoint_path=None, device='cpu'). Forward (N,2,T,27)->(N,num_classes). groups=8, block_size=41, n_out_features=256.
- signtalk_core.models.st_gcn: STGCN(nn.Module) (edge_importance_weighting=True, dropout=0.05) + build_st_gcn(...). Same input/output contract. Both factories mirror pose_tcn.build_model ckpt-loading (bare state_dict or {'state_dict':...}; eval mode).

Fixtures / tests (locations):
- core/tests/golden/make_graph_golden.py (committed generator). Fixtures: core/tests/golden/input_landmarks_graph.npz (keys: pose_subset [T,9,2], full_pose [T,33,2], left [T,21,2] NaN=absent, right [T,21,2] NaN=absent) and core/tests/golden/expected_graph_features.npy (shape (32,27,2) float32). Clip has a 2-hand frame AND a right-hand gap (one-absent-hand).
- Tests: core/tests/test_graph.py, test_graph_features.py, test_graph_models.py.
